'''2007 Worlds Team Dirk Friedrichs LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).

Team Jetlagh. Deck title Uber-Obi Helps Padme's Plan. Master Qui-Gon (V) / Uh-oh! may redlink.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Friedrichs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|We Have A Plan]]
* '''Stage:''' Team
